note: Design + arithmetic only. No rows-runA-* file exists or is implied. The grid (RUN-A*, ~800 requests) stays held on GATE-OPERAND-VALIDATION.

parm1.h1_frozen: pointer-stable p95 TTFT below transcript-grow p95, all 48 turns per arm per rep, disjoint 95% intervals, n >= 60 per arm

treated_definition: turn >= first_fire_turn (inclusive; the fixture's own per-rep counts are the inclusive ones: 48-21+1=28, 48-23+1=26, 48-2+1=47)

order_statistic_arithmetic.note: a q-quantile at n is decided by roughly the top n*(1-q) observations; the untreated prefix can therefore own 100% of the tail, not be averaged into it

rows.why: 48*0.05 = 2.4 < TAIL_MIN = 3 -> per-rep p95 inadmissible (this is why PARM-1 pools 3 reps)

order_statistic_arithmetic.load_bearing: at n=48 the tail needs 2.4 rows; at n=144 it needs 7.2; the untreated prefix supplies 60. 60 >> 7.2, so the prefix is never diluted away - it either supplies the whole tail or none of it, depending on a sign not knowable before the rows exist.

R-all.population: kind == 'turn' with finite ttft_ms; no turn conditioning

R-post.selection: turn >= fire_turn, fire_turn derived by infer_fire_turn(rows, arm) from row markers
R-post.population: each arm's own treated regime only
R-post.caveat: n differ per arm (141 vs 84), so a pointer-vs-grow R-post comparison is not an equal-n comparison

R-common.population: common treated window for all arms
R-common.caveat: equalises the window's index range, not exposure duration: pointer-stable keeps 25 of its 47 treated turns, lease-reopen 25 of 26

row_fields_note: evicted/digest_at/lease/prefix_sha256 exist only to VERIFY the fire turn in the rows; no reading trusts the fixture's declared constants

clauses: R-all is the frozen claim and is reported always, whether it separates the arms or not.
R-post and R-common are pre-registered secondary claims: reportable as evidence, never 'H1 confirmed'.
If R-all and R-common disagree in direction, the disagreement is itself the finding: publish it with both intervals and both n, and do not resolve it by preference.
Forbidden: choosing the reading after seeing the intervals; testing more than these three; dropping a reading because it is inconvenient; reporting any reading without its n.

errata.reason: PARM-1 is frozen and no rows exist; applying the errata now would pre-authorise a second claim before the data that would justify it, and would enable exactly the post-hoc reading switch the decision rule forbids. Apply only if the grid produces an R-all/R-common direction disagreement and the treated-window number is chosen for publication as a claim.

proposed_claim.name: CP-H1-COMMON
proposed_claim.statement: on the common treated window turn > 23, pointer-stable's p95 TTFT is below transcript-grow's
proposed_claim.statistic: analyze_stats.quantile_ci(values, 0.95) on selected ttft_ms; disjoint 95% intervals, the PARM-1 disjointness rule
proposed_claim.population: kind == 'turn', finite ttft_ms, turn > 23; 25 rows per arm per rep
proposed_claim.precedence: R-all (all 48 turns) remains the primary H1 claim; CP-H1-COMMON is additional and additive

fails_if: a reading's selector is not derivable from rows alone (rows carry only the eight named fields; R-post's n must move 28->26 when the marker moves T21->T23)
a reading carried as a claim sits below min_n_for(0.95)=60 at 3 reps
the fixture's declared fire turns differ from the fire turns observable in a synthetic 48-turn row sample (6 rows per regime)

red_green.mutant_red: select_r_post := lambda rows, fire_turn: _usable(rows) (ignores turn, returns all 48) -> AssertionError for every arm (28/26/47 != 48)
red_green.mutant_red_2: R-common promoted to a claim at 1 rep (n=25 < 60) -> underfloor AssertionError
red_green.green: the three real selectors pass and reproduce 48/28/26/47 per rep and 144/84/78/141/75 at 3 reps

guard.synthetic_rows_note: synth_rows() builds in-memory rows with fake ttft: plumbing only, never written to disk, never reported as a measurement

does_not_decide: whether the treatment matters at all
in which direction pooling distorts the arms

answer.question: does H1's frozen statistic measure the treatment or a mixture of regimes?
answer.what_the_fixture_fixes: which turns are treated, hence the mixture ratios 20/48, 20/48, 22/48, 1/48
answer.what_is_missing: the sign: whether the untreated regime is slower or faster, i.e. whether the mixed tail is owned by treated or untreated rows
answer.reading_that_would_answer_it: R-common (turn > 23), where all four treatments are already firing
